001-logo-refine-3.png.label: Recommended lockup + character master (J3)
001-logo-refine-3.png.note: Same mascot, cleaner: round bun head, flat fills, one outline weight, no tiny props. Chunky silhouette survives 24 px; heavy rounded wordmark keeps the original personality. Vectorised into the production SVG set.

001-logo-refine-7.png.label: Mark face reference (J7)
001-logo-refine-7.png.note: Largest pill eyes = best face read at 16–32 px. Production mark = J3 head + J7 eyes + J6 belt, rebuilt from geometric primitives.

001-logo-refine-6.png.label: Mark belt reference (J6)
001-logo-refine-6.png.note: Dark belt band with solid terracotta rollers is the only belt that still reads as a conveyor at 16 px.

001-logo-refine-4.png.label: Runner-up lockup (J4)
001-logo-refine-4.png.note: Also strong; taller body and footed belt cost legibility vs J3.
